column1: # P19 (ADR-0027): ZAP baseline rules for the gateway (passive scan). FAIL fails verify.sh full; every IGNORE says why.

column3: (Anti-clickjacking header missing: the gateway sends X-Frame-Options DENY on every response)
(X-Content-Type-Options missing: the gateway sends nosniff on every response)
(Information disclosure - debug error messages: errors are RFC 9457 problems without stack traces)
(Server leaks version information via the Server header)
(Content Security Policy header not set: the gateway sends default-src 'none')
(CSP: the API policy allows nothing; anything ZAP flags here is reviewed)
(Cross-domain misconfiguration: CORS is an allow-list, never *)
(Strict-Transport-Security: the local stack is plain HTTP; HSTS is sent on HTTPS only - EdgeFiltersIT)
(Timestamp disclosure: epoch seconds in JSON are token expiry and server time fields, by design)
(Absence of anti-CSRF tokens: bearer-token JSON API, no cookie session, no HTML forms)
(Storable / cacheable content: informational; authenticated responses carry Cache-Control no-store)
